classifications.authority_or_basis: CACEIS launch announcement identifies EURXT as a euro-denominated electronic money token issued by CACEIS Bank and backed 1:1 by euro-denominated fiat assets.

licensed_or_regulated_as: European Union electronic money token issuer
notes: The reviewed launch material establishes CACEIS Bank as issuer, EMT status and 1:1 euro backing. It does not establish token-specific reserve segregation or bankruptcy remoteness, so those fields remain unresolved.

classifications.authority_or_basis: Western Union launch announcement identifies USDPT as a U.S.-dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank.

notes: Reviewed materials establish Anchorage Digital Bank as issuer, full U.S.-dollar backing and a reserve-attestation program. They do not establish the complete holder-claim, reserve-ownership, segregation or bankruptcy-remoteness terms used by this registry, so those boundaries remain explicit.
